Given an array of N integers, find the largest and smallest element.

def find_min_max(arr):
    if not arr: return None, None
    mn = mx = arr[0]
    for x in arr[1:]:
        if x < mn: mn = x
        if x > mx: mx = x
    return mn, mx

questions.title: Left Rotate Array by D Places
questions.question:
Given an array of N integers and a value D, left rotate the array by D places.

Example: [1,2,3,4,5,6,7], D=3 => [4,5,6,7,1,2,3]
questions.explanation: Optimal reversal algorithm: reverse first D, reverse remaining, reverse all. O(n) time, O(1) space. Alternative: store in temp array.

hints.text: Three reversals: first D, rest, then all

solution.code:
def left_rotate_d(arr, d):
    n = len(arr)
    d = d % n
    def reverse(lo, hi):
        while lo < hi:
            arr[lo], arr[hi] = arr[hi], arr[lo]
            lo += 1
            hi -= 1
    reverse(0, d-1)
    reverse(d, n-1)
    reverse(0, n-1)
    return arr
